title: ApiErrorEnvelope
description: The error body sent on every non-2xx response — docs/API_CONTRACT.md §1 「Error envelope (always)」: `{ "error": { "code": …, "message": …, "details": {}, "request_id": … } }`. `error` is the only top-level key. Spec §104 reliability, §105 AI failure handling.

ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: API_CONTRACT §1's enumerated codes, each with a fixed HTTP status (`ERROR_CODE_STATUS` in `src/enums.ts`). NOTE: §1's *example* uses `merchant_not_found`, which is not one of the eight; the enumeration is treated as the closed domain and the resource is carried in `details` (CONTRACT NOTES 9 in `src/enums.ts`).

message.description: Localised to the caller's locale (AGENT_CONTRACT §12). Never a stack trace, never chain-of-thought (spec §116).

details.description: Structured context: `resource`/`reason` for `not_found`, `http_status`, `retry_after` for `rate_limited` (API §1 `Retry-After`), `stage`/`fallback`/`retryable` for `ai_unavailable` (the failure ladder).

request_id.description: Echoed `X-Request-Id` — API_CONTRACT §1 「attached to logs, agent_runs, audit_logs」.

field_errors.description: Per-path validation messages when `code` is `validation_error`. Paths are dotted (`intent.budget.max`), so this map is exempt from the snake_case key rule.
